resources.string: Kinsight
Screen time for your family. Phones share it directly with each other over Bluetooth: no accounts, no servers.
Create a family group
Join with a QR code
Create a group on a parent\'s phone.
Join on a child\'s phone or on a second parent\'s phone, using the QR code from the group\'s admin.
Continue
Back
Agree
Not now
Name this phone
Your family will see this name.
Phone name
Use 1 to 64 characters, without invisible or control characters.
What this phone does
This phone shows the screen time of the children in your family group. It does not share its own screen time with anyone.
Data moves only between your family\'s phones over Bluetooth. Nothing goes to the internet, to servers or to us.
What your family will see

Kinsight counts how much time this phone spends in each app, how often it is unlocked and at what hours it is used. Kinsight sends this over Bluetooth to the phones of every parent in your family group (currently %1$s) and parents who join later. They will see this time for today and past days. Counting happens in the background, even when Kinsight is closed.

Kinsight counts how much time this phone spends in each app, how often it is unlocked and at what hours it is used. Kinsight sends this over Bluetooth to the phones of every parent in your family group, including parents who join later. They will see this time for today and past days. Counting happens in the background, even when Kinsight is closed.
When you agree, the first sending also includes up to the last 7 days of screen time that this phone has already recorded.

Nothing goes to the internet, to servers or to us. A Kinsight notification is always shown on this phone. If you hide it, sharing pauses until you turn the notification back on: your family sees that it is hidden, and the time counted meanwhile is sent once it is shown again.
You can pause sharing in two taps. Your family will see the pause, and the time during the pause will be sent once you resume. Sharing cannot be hidden, only openly stopped.
Google Play Protect may tell you that a parental control app is installed. This is expected.
If you choose Not now, this phone joins the group without sharing, and your family sees that it does not share.
Nearby devices
Kinsight finds your family\'s phones nearby over Bluetooth and exchanges screen time with them. Kinsight does not use Bluetooth to find out where you are.
To join a group, Kinsight needs Nearby devices. Tap Agree and allow it, or allow it in the app\'s settings.
Scan the invitation
On the admin\'s phone open Group, tap an invite button and scan the QR code shown there. You can also scan it with this phone\'s camera app.
This is not a Kinsight invitation.
This invitation is from another version of Kinsight. Update Kinsight on both phones.
The camera could not be opened. Scan the code with this phone\'s camera app.
Kinsight may not use the camera. Scan the code with this phone\'s camera app, or allow the camera.
Camera
Kinsight uses the camera only on the next screen, to read the invitation QR code. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere. Without the camera you can scan the code with this phone\'s camera app.
Allow camera
Usage access

To count screen time, Kinsight needs usage access. Kinsight reads which apps were open and when, and sends the totals only to your family\'s phones. Android settings will open next: find Kinsight and turn on Usage access.
Agree, open settings
Notifications

While sharing is on, Kinsight always shows a notification saying who sees your screen time. Kinsight also tells you when a new parent joins. If you turn notifications off, your family will see that the notification is off on this phone.
Kinsight shows a notification while it syncs, tells you when a child pauses sharing or is out of contact, and sends a daily summary.
Keep Kinsight running
Some phones stop apps in the background. Let Kinsight run without battery restrictions so your family\'s phones stay in sync.
Open battery settings
Kinsight already runs without battery restrictions.
Settings → Battery → Background usage limits → Never sleeping apps → add Kinsight. Also: Settings → Apps → Kinsight → Battery → Unrestricted.
Settings → Apps → Kinsight → App battery usage → Unrestricted.
Settings → Apps → Manage apps → Kinsight: turn on Autostart, and set Battery saver to No restrictions.
Settings → Battery → App launch → Kinsight → Manage manually: allow auto-launch, secondary launch and run in background.
Settings → Battery → Battery optimisation → Kinsight → Don\'t optimise. Also: Settings → Apps → Kinsight → Battery → Allow background activity.
Settings → Battery → More settings → Optimise battery use → Kinsight → Don\'t optimise. Also allow background activity for Kinsight.
Settings → Battery → Background power consumption management → Kinsight → Allow.
Tap the button below, then: App info → App battery usage → Unrestricted. The exact path depends on the phone maker.
All set
Next: invite your child\'s phone from the Group tab.
This phone is in your family group.
Open Kinsight

Your parents will see how much time you spend on your phone and in which apps.
Could not turn on sharing. Try again, or open Settings → Diagnostics on this phone.
Open app settings
Nearby devices is turned off for Kinsight and Android will not ask again. Open the app\'s settings, then Permissions → Nearby devices → Allow.
This phone is in your family group. It shows your children\'s screen time once their phones sync.
